_comment: Copy to config/mcp_servers.json and edit. JARVIS connects to each enabled server on startup, lists its tools, and exposes them to Gemini. Set 'disabled': true to skip one.
_how_to_add: Two kinds of servers: LOCAL (a program launched on your machine via 'command'+'args') and REMOTE (a hosted server via 'url'). Add as many as you like.
_windows_note: Local npx servers need the cmd wrapper on Windows: command='cmd', args=['/c','npx',...]. Local binaries: point 'command' at the .exe. Remote servers need no install.
